summary: RoyaLand Co Ltd., a Bermuda holding company, filed a Form 6-K on September 1, 2026, attaching a press release announcing personnel appointments for its Italian soccer club Savoia 1908 FC. Davide Mignemi was named Sporting Director and Alessandro Formisano as First-Team Head Coach. No financial terms, share prices, or strategic corporate changes were disclosed. This is a routine operational announcement regarding sports management hires, not a special-situation corporate event such as an acquisition, restructuring, or management change at the parent company level.
